reviews.title: Awesome Power Supply
reviews.comment:
Only been running it one day, but seems like an awesome power supply.  Extremely quiet.  Comes with all needed cables.
--Note for those that seem to believe that the 4 pin CPU cables are missing... instead of two 4 pin cables, there is a single 8 pin to separable 2x4 pin connector.

reviews.author: Allen

reviews.title: Solid and reliable product
reviews.comment:
This product replaced a Corsair CX750 (Green Label), and going from nonmodular to a fully modular power supply was a game changer in my micro-ATX Okinos Cypress 3 case. The modular system and good quality cables freed up a lot of space and added to the aesthetics of my black colored case. I read in some reviews about concerns over the product's fan noise, but I don't have that issue. I have to literally bring my ear right next to the power supply basement of my case to hear fan noise, and this is under load with Space Marine 2 running.
I'm overall very pleased with this product. If you have a Ryzen 5800X3D with an RTX 5060 Ti on an Asus , then you can expect about the same product satisfaction as I do.
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: It's a solid, Tier B power supply
reviews.comment:
Great quality item.  Tier B on the PSU Cultist list.  Plenty of cables and quiet, too.
HOWEVER, I bought 3 of these, all "renewed", and one was an ASRock power supply that I guess the previous owner had labeled and returned as the Rosewill model.  It was evidently easy to do because Rosewill, for some reason, includes a side label (one is already mounted on one side of the power supply) so buyers can mount the label on the blank side making it very easy for the jerk who originally purchased the Rosewill to keep it and send back a defective other brand.  Naturally, the people handling the returns failed to notice it.  Regardless, I was able to return the offending psu but then couldn't replace the unit with another refurb because they were no longer in stock.  Not really Amazon's fault.
